patch.value: Do not ignore source paths, lower thresholds, use vacuous assertions, or duplicate artificial tests merely to satisfy counters. Exercise public behavior and real SDK-host dispatch where applicable.

Close every genuine coverage gap in index.ts with behavior-driven tests, including real installed importer/exporter/command paths, then enforce 100 percent statements, branches, functions, and lines in release:check. Current honest baseline is 68.06/84.23/67.94/68.06.

c8 reports 100 percent statements, branches, functions, and lines for index.ts; package release:check enforces all four thresholds; tests use real throwaway trackers and installed extension dispatch where integration behavior matters; mutation or equivalent anti-cheat evidence proves assertions detect regressions; tests remain deterministic and avoid duplicated cases
Run NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=/dev/null npx --yes c8@12.0.0 --all --include=dist/index.js --reporter=text node --test dist-test/*.js and inspect the aggregate row.
All maintained TypeScript source is behaviorally exercised and the mandatory release gate rejects any metric below 100 percent.
Baseline: 68.06 statements, 84.23 branches, 67.94 functions, and 68.06 lines; release:check currently has no coverage threshold.
Untested command, importer, exporter, and failure branches can regress without blocking a release.
